fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM84,290. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0003075/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: i. Pass in Matriculation or Foundation studies with a minimum CGPA of 2.00; OR pass in STPM or equivalent with minimum Grade C (GP 2.00) in any 2 subjects and a credit in the following at SPM level or equivalent: a) Additional Mathematics; OR b) Mathematics and one Science, Technology or Engineering subject. Note: Students under i b) must take and pass Mathematics reinforcement subjects before proceeding to relevant core courses unless exempted by prior qualifications. ii. Pass STPM in Science stream or equivalent with minimum Grade C (GP 2.00) in one Mathematics and one Science/ICT subject; OR iii. Diploma in Computer Science / Software Engineering / IT / Information Systems or equivalent with minimum CGPA of 2.50; OR iv. Any other Diploma in science and technology with minimum CGPA of 2.50. Note: Candidates with CGPA between 2.00 and 2.49 may be admitted subject to a rigorous internal assessment process.
